definition: Recent route carrier transit days: recent typical carrier-to-customer time on the route
formula: as route_recent_delivery_days, on (delivery date - carrier date)

definition: Recent route delivery days: recent typical purchase-to-delivery time on the route
formula: weighted 3-week mean (0.5, 0.3, 0.2) of the route's weekly median lead days; < 10 route events -> 0.7 x seller state + 0.3 x customer state, then overall

definition: Prior seller dispatch days: mean days from purchase to carrier handover over the seller's earlier orders
formula: mean of (carrier date - purchase time) over the seller's earlier handovers; same fallback

definition: Prior seller late-handover days: mean days by which the seller's earlier handovers missed the shipping limit (0 if on time)
formula: mean of max(0, carrier date - last shipping_limit_date) over the seller's earlier handovers; same fallback

definition: Days from purchase to this order's carrier handover
formula: carrier date - purchase time of this order

definition: Route of the order: primary seller's state to the customer's state
Prior seller late-handover rate: share of the seller's earlier handovers made after their last shipping limit
formula: mean over the seller's handovers in weeks before the prediction week of 1[carrier date > last shipping_limit_date]; new seller: weighted 3-week mean of sellers in the same state

definition: Days this order's handover missed the shipping limit (0 if on time)
formula: max(0, carrier date - last shipping_limit_date) of this order

definition: This order was handed to the carrier after its last shipping limit
formula: 1[carrier date > last shipping_limit_date] of this order (known at handover)
